warnings: *** THIS DETAIL IS THE TARGET OF THE รางระบายน้ำ คสล. ดูแบบขยาย CALLOUT ON A-03 AND SN-01 - both of which were recorded with callout_names_no_target_sheet because neither names a sheet. SN-02 carries the only gutter enlargement in the set, so both callouts resolve here. The flags on those two files stay as the record that the drawings themselves do not say so.

IT IS THE SECOND ARCHITECTURAL-SIDE ELEMENT IN THE SET WITH REAL REINFORCEMENT, after A-11's concrete vanity counter - ø6 มม.@0.20 ม., which matches S-01's material note that ø6 is SR-24 round bar. Neither appears on any S sheet.

The 0.10 / 0.40 / 0.10 chain gives a 0.60 m overall gutter with 0.10 m walls and a 0.40 m clear channel; the cover slab spans that 0.40 m clear. The 0.03 / 0.05 / 0.25 figures at the top of the detail dimension the cover seating.
